# 4 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> An elegant 4 bedroom Victorian town house which has been extended and improved to create a wonderful family home with a garage and off-road parking. No forward chain. The property offers an exceptional balance of elegant formal rooms and relaxed family living spaces, complemented by high ceilings, generous proportions and an array of attractive period features throughout.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 212 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Manor Road, Wiltshire
- Cena: £875,000
